one_liner: Creator monetization platform for fan memberships, payments, and subscriptions
blocker: Official API docs are password-protected at dev-docs.fanbasis.com; no public documentation or developer signup flow visible in supplied material

evidence.claim: FanBasis API docs exist but are behind a password login, blocking public access
evidence.quote: Sign in to access API Docs. Invalid password. Please try again. Password. Login.

evidence.claim: FanBasis supports API keys created from the account settings
evidence.quote: Create an API key. To do this, go to Account > API Keys. Make sure to give access to the correct audiences.

evidence.claim: Third-party integration tooling references FanBasis API credentials and webhook events
evidence.quote: Provide your FanBasis API credentials or connect through Zapier triggers for webhook events.

evidence.claim: FanBasis is a creator monetization / fan experience platform
evidence.quote: navigate FanBasis to create and manage personalized fan experiences, memberships, and community interactions

notes: The supplied 'Commas API Reference' (commasdocs.com) appears to be an unrelated Merchant-of-Record/payments API, not FanBasis, so it was excluded from evidence. FanBasis docs are versioned 'API Docsv3' but password-gated, so endpoint breadth, style, and credential self-service cannot be confirmed. No vendor-shipped MCP server found in supplied material.
